book.name: Mgo Hinimuan
book.title: KA MGO HINIMUAN to mgo Suguanon ni Hisus

content: Nò, nigtongtongan ni Pablo ka mgo pogbuyagon, no kagi rin to, “Mgo sulod no pinanganak ni Israil, maawang ka goinawa ku to Magboboot su taman kuntoon, nig–ayad–ayad ad to ogpaagad–agad kandin.”
No si Ananias no ian Labow no Talagpanubad dan, nigsugu to songo otow no nigsasindog to longod ni Pablo to, “Tagpia now kun ka bo–bo ni Pablo.”

Kagi ni Pablo ki Ananias to, “Sikoykow, songo ogkalogparan ka to Magboboot su ogparoyowroyow ka su ogbobootan a nu poron, no ka Balaod ta ka igsokod nu to batasan ku. Dokad di, niglop–ang ka to sikan no Balaod no insugu nu to igpatagpi a nu,” kagi ni Pablo ki Ananias.
Kagi to dangob no mgo otow no marani ki Pablo to, “Manio to ogmarooton nu ka Labow no Talagpanubad no pig–alam to Magboboot?”
Kagi ni Pablo to, “Ko nataga a pa to Labow no Talagpanubad ka nigkagi, waro a poron nigkagi to sikan su duon ingkasulat no kinagian to Magboboot to, ‘Kono now maroota ka igbuyag now.’ ”

Pogpitow ni Pablo to mgo pogbuyagon, nigkita rin to mgo Parisiu ka songo baad woy mgo Sadusiu ka dangob no baad. No su natagaan ni Pablo to nigloinloin ka pogtuu to sikan no mgo otow nigbabansagon to, “Mgo sulod, Parisiu a woy songo Parisiu ka mgo kaap–apuan ku. Nokoy naan to duon a kai to tangkaan now kuntoon su og–in–insaan a tongod to pogtuu ku to duon allow uromo no ogkouyag to Magboboot ka mgo nammatoy.”
Pogdinog to mgo pogbuyagon to kagi ni Pablo, nabaad on ka pogdoromdom to sikan no mgo nalimud no pogbuyagon no nigbunsud on nigpaap–apuloy ka mgo Parisiu woy ka mgo Sadusiu.
Ian su kagi to mgo Sadusiu to waro pogkouyag to mgo nammatoy, waro diwata woy songo waro gimukud. Di ka mgo Parisiu, ogtuu atag to sikan tibo.

Sikan ian no nigmabanbansagonoy on ka mgo pogbuyagon woy duon mgo talag–anad to mgo Balaod ni Moisis no tahan nig–amut to mgo Parisiu. Nigsasindog on sikandan no nigpangabang ki Pablo to kagi ran to, “Waro pigkita noy no salo ni Pablo. Agad naan ko duon gimukud woy ko diwata to Magboboot no nigkagi ki Pablo, waro man makasalo,” kagi ran.

No natimtimulan on ka pogmaap–apuloy ran no inat to ogmoog–ogotoy on ka mgo pogbuyagon. No sikan ian to nigsugu to igbuyag to mgo sundalu oyow og–awoon dan on si Pablo su kakuwo to oghigbithigbiton dan on. No impalibong din on si Pablo dio to baloy to mgo sundalu.

Nò, pogliwaro to marusilom, nigpakita ka Lagboy no Igbuyag ta no si Hisus dio ki Pablo. Kagi ni Hisus to, “Kono ka ogkahallok su unawa to impamalogot nu ka kinagian ku kai to Hirusalim, songo og–awoson no igpamalogot nu rod dio to Ruma.”
Pogkapawo, duon mgo Hudiu no nigmouy–uyunoy woy nangulibot sikandan to woy ran ogkoon woy og–inum to agad nokoy ko ogkohimatayan dan on si Pablo.
No ka nigmouy–uyunoy to sikan, nigsubla to kohop–atan no otow.

No nanhondio sikandan to mgo igbuyag to mgo talagpanubad woy ka mgo pogbuyagon to mgo Hudiu. No kagi ran to, “Nighogot ka goinawa noy lagboy su nangulibot koy to woy koy on ogkoon woy ko og–inum to agad nokoy ko ogkohimatayan noy on si Pablo.

Sikan ian, sikaniu no mgo igbuyag to mgo talagpanubad woy tibo kaniu no mgo pogbuyagon to mgo Hudiu, buyua now dio to igbuyag to mgo sundalu oyow ighutuk din ighatod si Pablo kai to kaniu. No honduonan now to ian now igpohondini su og–ay–ayaron now to og–insoinso kandin tongod to pighimu rin. Dokad di, nig–indan koy to, woy ogpokouma si Pablo kai to kaniu, oghimatayan noy on.”

Di duon anakon ni Pablo no lukos no anak to atoboy rin no nakarinog to tuud to mgo otow to oggopasan dan poron si Pablo. Nighondio to kampu to mgo sundalu no nignangonan din si Pablo to sikan no pigdinog din.
Pogkataga ni Pablo, nig–umow rin ka sagboka to mgo kapitan no kagi ni Pablo to, “Ihatod nu ka soini no balubato dio to igbuyag to mgo sundalu su duon ignangon din.”

Pogkaponga, inhatod to kapitan ka balubato dio to igbuyag to mgo sundalu. Kagi to kapitan to, “Si Pablo no napirisu, nig–umow kanak woy impahatod din ka soini no balubato kai to koykow su duon ignangon din koykow.”
Nò, nigkitkit to kapitan ka balubato to nigdapig no nigtungop to nig–inso kandin to, “Nokoy ka ignangon nu kanak?”

Kagi to balubato to, “Nigmouy–uyunoy on ka mgo Hudiu to ogbuyu koykow to oyow ighatod nu si Pablo dio to ogkalimud no mgo pogbuyagon dan asolom. Oghonduonon dan to og–ay–ayaran dan to og–insoinso to pighimu ni Pablo.

Di kono nu ibogoy su subla to kohop–atan ka mgo otow no ogmanggopas dio to dalan no nangulibot sikandan to woy ran ogkoon woy ko og–inum to agad nokoy ko ogkohimatayan dan on si Pablo. No kuntoon, ian dan do tagaran ko oghoohoo ka to sikan no ogbuyuon dan koykow to ighatod nud si Pablo dio to pogbuyagon to mgo Hudiu. Ian su nig–indanan on to oggopasan dan si Pablo,” kagi to balubato.
Pogkaponga, pinalibuwas on to igbuyag to mgo sundalu ka balubato no pigsaparan din sikandin to, “Kono nu nangoni ka agad hontow to nignangonan a nu to soini.”

Pogkaponga, nig–umow rin ka daruwa no kapitan no kagi to igbuyag dan to, “Limura now on ka daruwa no gatus no sundalu no oghipanow, woy kapituan no sundalu no ogpanguddo, woy daruwa no gatus no sundalu no og–alap to kommag. Tagama kow on oyow ogpakaligkat kow on angkuwan to alas nuibi
to kuntoon do no marusilom su ogsuguan kow dio to lunsud to Sisaria.
Woy alap kow to mgo kuddo oyow ogpakasakoy si Pablo. No ay–ayari now ka pog–alap now kandin dio ki Gobirnador Pilik oyow kono ogkoomonu.”
No duon insulat to sikan no igbuyag to sundalu. No kagi to sulat to:
“Sikanak no si Klaudiu Lisias, ogpangumustoon ku sikoykow no tahuronon no Gobirnador Pilik.

Ka soini otow no igpahatod ku dio to koykow, narakop to mgo Hudiu. No ko waro ku pa poron moumoi sikandin, oghimatayan dan on poron. Duon mgo sundalu no nigduma kanak no nigpapangabangan ku si Pablo su nanangonan a to nasakup sikandin to gobirnu ta no dio to Ruma.
Nò, noiniatan ku to ogkabatukan ku ko nokoy ka igbabayung to mgo Hudiu ki Pablo. Sikan ian to inhatod ku pad sikandin dio to nalimud on ka mgo pogbuyagon dan.

Di ian ku ro ingkabatuk ku tongod ki Pablo, to waro man hinimuan din no litos to igkamatoy rin woy songo waro salo din litos to igkapirisu rin. Ian do igbayung dan ki Pablo ka tongod do to kandan do no balaod to mgo Hudiu.

No ian to in–agpas ku impahatod si Pablo dio to koykow su nanangonan ad to duon mgo otow no nigmouy–uyunoy to oggopasan sikandin. No nigsuguan ku ka mgo otow no nigbayung ki Pablo to oyow songo oghondio koykow oyow ognangonan dan sikoykow ko nokoy ka ingkabolu dan kandin.” Sikan do ka tagu to sulat no igpaalap to gobirnador.
Nò, nigpaagad–agad to mgo sundalu ka innangon to igbuyag dan. No ko marusilom on, inhatod dan on si Pablo dio to lunsud to Antipatria.
Mapawo, ka mgo sundalu no nighipanow ro, nan–uli on dio to kampu to mgo sundalu. No ian do nigparagas ka mgo sundalu no nanguddo no oghatod ki Pablo dio to Sisaria.
Pogkouma ran dio to lunsud to Sisaria, imbogoy ran on ka sulat ligkat to igbuyag to mgo sundalu woy songo imbogoy ran on si Pablo dio to gobirnador.
Pogkaponga to gobirnador to ogbasa to sulat, nig–inso din si Pablo ko hondoi ka ugpaan din no probinsia. Kagi ni Pablo, “Silisia.”

Kagi ni Gobirnador Pilik to, “Woy ad og–insoinso koykow ko ogpokouma on ka mgo otow no ogbayung koykow.” Pogkaponga, nigpabantayan si Pablo to sundalu no dio mokougpo to baloy no impohimu nokani ni Igbuyag Hirodis.

footnotes.text: Ka alas nuibi, ogtakas to oglabung.
